title: Player movement and interaction baseline
inputs: Measure standing, walking, sprinting and crouching on a level marked route
Repeat pickup, carry, place and throw trials with at least three mass classes
Record control bindings, frame rate, start/end markers and object state
expected: Standing eye height and base serialized movement settings resolve to database records
Runtime sprint/crouch speeds and transitions are captured as repeated observations
Interaction reach and carry/throw outcomes are recorded without save mutation
toleranceNotes: Static serialized values use their record tolerances. Runtime values require at least five trials and median plus observed range before validation.
